content: प्रत्यञ्च्, -प्रत्यच् {%a.%} .({@-प्रतीची@} {%f.%} or according to Vopadeva प्रत्यञ्ची also) .²1 Turned or directed towards; turned inward; मनः प्रत्यक् चित्ते सविधमवधायात्तमरुतः <ls>Śivamahimna 25</ls>. .²2 Being behind. .²3 Following, subsequent; समेत्य तरसा प्रत्यग्द्वाभ्यां पद्भ्यां बलं बली . निहत्य <ls>Bhāg. 10. 15. 30</ls>. .²4 Averted, turned away, turning back; <ls>Pt. 3. 181</ls>. .²5 Western, westerly. .²6 Inner, interior. .²7 Equal to, a match for. --{%m.%} .²1 The individual soul. .²2 Future time.
